verb: sweeping sickle claws that keep you at length, a hook that drags you in, a two-arm overhead rake that bleeds
prompt: Therizinosaurus from the owner's turnaround sheet: a tall, pot-bellied feathered biped with a long upright neck, a small toothy beak and a pink wattle, long arms each ending in three huge black sickle claws, sturdy scaly legs and a feathered tail fan
texture_prompt: dark slate and blue-purple feathers, lavender scaly belly and legs with violet streaks, pale pink-orange scaly arm and foot skin, grey beak with a red-pink wattle and throat, glossy black claws, matte surface
look: 10 meter Therizinosaurus standing about 5 m tall, long feathered neck held high, small grey beak and a pink wattle, pot belly, long arms with three huge black sickle claws per hand, feathered tail fan, dark slate-blue feathers over lavender scaly skin,

clips.attack_primary: Claw sweep: the right arm cocks out to its right, then the sickle claws sweep low across its front at survivor height; a landed sweep shoves the target back to claw's length
clips.attack_heavy: Overhead rake: rears up hissing, both arms raised high with the claws fanned and trembling (the telegraph), then drives both down through the target and rakes them back to its chest; bleeds
clips.bite_combo: Hook and rake: the right claws reach out and hook the target, dragging it in to the chest, a left backhand slash, then it rears with both arms cocked at the shoulders and thrusts both claw sets forward and down
clips.alert: Threat display: rears up tall, neck high, arms flung wide and raised with the claws fanned, beak open hissing, the claws shaking, the tail fan raised
clips.knockdown: Knees buckle and it topples onto its right side, arms folded in
clips.feed: Browses high: neck stretched up, the right claws hook a branch down, the beak strips it

coloration._note: the hide's feather and scale colours are painted; a small natural range and no added stripes

pipeline.route: tools/gait/rig_biped.py (hand-placed skeleton with Claw bones) + tools/jaw/add_jaw.py + tools/gait (make_gait, make_theri_moves)
pipeline.mesh: Tripo P1 multiview: front and back cropped from the owner sheet (rescaled to the side view's height), left a Codex neutral-stance side view, right its mirror. Task 65b2aab3-3547-48b0-a1c2-923f7cb395e0, 50 Tripo credits, no retry.
pipeline._hit_parts: canon's bone hit check (Creature.part_hit): at the hit frame one claw-tip marker (ClawTip.L/R, non-deforming bones at the middle sickle claw's tip) must be within radius_m (x body size) of the target's body. # ASSUMPTION radii.

authored_clips.run: make_gait therizinosaurus.json run (heavy jog, arms tucked, claws curled)
authored_clips.attack_heavy: make_theri_moves.py two-arm overhead rake, telegraph held to 0.6, hit 0.72
authored_clips.bite_combo: make_theri_moves.py hook (0.092, pulls), backhand (0.338), rear-up tell (0.5-0.667), double thrust (0.815)
authored_clips.knockdown: make_theri_moves.py topple onto the right side, arms folded
authored_clips.sleep: make_theri_moves.py belly-down, arms folded back, neck curled
authored_clips.feed: make_theri_moves.py high browse, claw hooks a branch down
